responsibilities: Serve as a technical partner to the business, ensuring deep understanding of operational needs to deliver the most relevant and impactful data solutions.
Manage and execute the end-to-end data request pipeline, ensuring timely, accurate delivery and clear communication with stakeholders.
Write, implement, and optimize complex SQL transformations for data cleaning, aggregation, joining, and business logic.
Develop and execute organizational data flows to move data securely across departments, maintaining a clear overview of any changes.
Proactively identify, investigate, and fix discrepancies, failures, and performance degradation in data ingestion and transformation jobs.
Deliver continuous development and optimization of the data warehouse to ensure it contains high-quality, relevant data for operational and analytical needs.
Administer and manage the analytics consumption environment (e.g Civis and Tableau), ensuring smooth data access and utilization by the business.
Create, test, and run complex standard and ad-hoc queries for data integrity assurance and specific data extraction initiatives (e.g., fundraising appeals).

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Create, test, and run complex standard and ad-hoc queries for data integrity assurance and specific data extraction initiatives (e.g., fundraising appeals).
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Accuracy and integrity language runs through the responsibilities ("data integrity assurance", "ensuring timely, accurate delivery", "high-quality data assets") with no shipping-speed vocabulary to offset it.
evidence.domain_risk: build, maintain, and optimize the data solutions that power our mission-critical operations
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The JD calls the operations the data supports "mission-critical" and the work covers fundraising and financial data plus "sensitive information", so errors carry more than decision-support cost.
evidence.collaboration_width: None named; the JD refers only to "the business", "stakeholders" and "departments", all of which are excluded as generic.
evidence.data_team_maturity: You will be an integral part of the CRM, Automation, and Intelligence (CAI) team.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named unit, a running data warehouse and a live Civis/Tableau stack already exist and appear in the responsibilities as things to maintain and optimize, but there are no sub-teams or scale signals.
evidence.jd_authorship: Administer and manage the analytics consumption environment (e.g Civis and Tableau), ensuring smooth data access and utilization by the business.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name the actual platforms and the actual tasks — Civis and Tableau administration, incremental warehouse changes, data retention, ad-hoc pulls for fundraising appeals — so the day-to-day is legible.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: so that Greenpeace Nordic can build rewarding, engaging and financially successful relationships with our supporters
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The team exists to serve supporter fundraising, the data domains named are "marketing, fundraising or financial data", and the hiring contact is the Fundraising Manager — the audience is the revenue-generating function.
evidence.autonomy_level: We're looking for an Analytics Engineer focused on execution and delivery
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The JD says outright the role is "focused on execution and delivery", and every responsibility verb is deliver, administer, execute or fix rather than define or set direction.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI, ML and coding assistants are absent from the posting, so no AI skill is expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Create, test, and run complex standard and ad-hoc queries for data integrity assurance
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing sits in the responsibilities as something the candidate does for data integrity, not as a tool name in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Proactively identify, investigate, and fix discrepancies, failures, and performance degradation in data ingestion and transformation jobs.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The fear on the page is broken pipelines and a warehouse that is not intact — operational reliability — with no compliance, audit or stakeholder-trust register, and delivery still leads the framing.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: This role’s primary responsibility is implementing and maintaining robust data pipelines and delivering high-quality data assets to the business.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Maintain, optimize and fix dominate throughout — an existing warehouse, an existing Civis platform and an existing data request pipeline are the objects of the work.
evidence.language_gate: Communicate with excellent English; proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage.
evidence.loss_aversion: Risk framing is operational: "Proactively identify, investigate, and fix discrepancies, failures, and performance degradation in data ingestion and transformation jobs", alongside "ensure that our data warehouse is intact". No compliance or audit language appears.
